desc: 冲孔镂空清爽透气，撞色几何棚拍，逐格拆解透气孔与柔韧大底
leaf: 女款冲孔镂空透气薄底系带休闲鞋
name: 冲孔镂空清爽透气休闲鞋款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼点击：高饱和撞色几何台上成双上脚，用清爽夏日色域与镂空鞋面建立第一好感。
shots.textZone: 左上三分区：#1A1A1A 标签条 + 主标题 + 一条虚线标签

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心主张：正侧立面配放大镜式虚线圈，把透气镂空这件事说得不用读字。
shots.textZone: 顶部横带主标题 + 放大镜圈旁一条标签

shots.intent: 先让买家对号入座：不透气闷脚的夏日摩擦与镂空方案左右同框对照。
shots.textZone: 底部横贯两栏：一条主痛点标题

shots.intent: 微距把冲孔阵列与面材质感摊开，让透气主张有可见证据而非口号。
shots.textZone: 右下角一条标签配细引线

shots.intent: 编号引线逐点交代侧身结构、鞋眼排与鞋口边，替买家看清侧面全部细节。
shots.textZone: 右侧三条编号引线标签 + 右上 #1A1A1A 标签条

shots.intent: 用手把鞋对折的实测画面替代形容词，直观回答硬不硬、磨不磨脚。
shots.textZone: 右列一条主标题压在虚线上 + 弧线标注

shots.intent: 仰视把大底纹路与侧墙厚度摊开给买家看，回应耐磨与轻量的判断需求。
shots.textZone: 大底纹路右侧一条短标签加细引线

shots.intent: 下半身实景让买家代入日常通勤与逛街场景，只拍膝下不泄露模特身份。
成双成列俯视平铺把可选配色一眼摊开，替买家完成挑选这一步。
shots.textZone: 每组下方一枚 #1A1A1A 标签芯片

shots.intent: 规格屏把选码依据一次交代清楚，消掉买大买小的决策成本。
shots.textZone: 下部两列细线表格 + 鞋身尺寸括号标注 + 顶部 #1A1A1A 标签条

shots.intent: 三格同光实证收口信任：用可见的孔排、弯折与内里证据替代虚构资质。
shots.textZone: 顶部一条虚线主标题 + 每格下方一枚标签

shots.intent: 收口屏用同一撞色语言重申主张并给出行动位，不靠虚构促销制造紧迫感。
shots.textZone: 右上主标题 + 一枚圆角行动按钮

style.backgroundSystem: flat matte painted color-block fields in saturated #2FB6EF with one #F4D514 corner block and a hairline #FFFFFF taped line, plus a clean #FFFFFF or pale #F2FBFF panel for spec and macro screens; recurring #FFFFFF painted wire-grid panel and gingham cards as constant set pieces; never random scenery, never printed texture, never gradient
style.direction: bold pop color-block summer footwear detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms, dashed circular badges and numbered circular markers with hairline leaders, dashed arc annotations with arrowheads in #1A1A1A; no 3D, no gradients, no filled illustration
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light from the upper left at 5800K, crisp but soft-edged contact shadows, one single light direction in every screen, gentle rim only when the outsole is shown
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold pop color-block summer-footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF, saturated sky #2FB6EF and lemon #F4D514 as base fields with #1A1A1A as the single accent and the only ink color; cool bright tone at 5800K; modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin copy, one solid #1A1A1A tag header with a short arrow plus one headline per screen, dashed hairline rules, no serif or handwritten faces; background system of flat matte painted color-block fields with a hairline #FFFFFF taped line, one #FFFFFF painted wire-grid panel and gingham cards, never random scenery and never printed texture; lighting system of bright high-key studio light from the upper left with crisp soft-edged contact shadows and one single light direction in every screen; layout system of solid #1A1A1A tag headers with a short arrow, dashed rules, numbered circular markers, dashed circular badges and one callout leader style; icon system of thin single-weight line pictograms only, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows on icons; product presentation rules: true proportions, stable slight 3/4 front, clean 90-degree side, high 45-degree or 90-degree overhead geometry, identical scale and centering across all screens, vent-hole spacing and eyelet-row scale never changing, every sole grounded with a visible contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no scale drift between screens.
noDrift: no invented perforation or eyelet geometry
style.presentationRules: true proportions and stable geometry: slight 3/4 front, clean 90-degree side, high 45-degree or 90-degree overhead only as specified; vent-hole spacing, hole count per row and eyelet-row scale never change between screens; identical shoe scale and centering across screens; every sole grounded with a visible contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: seamless painted paper ground and matte color-block floor, #FFFFFF painted wire-grid overlay laid on top of the color field, pale #EDEAE6 band for dimension lines
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin copy, single ink #1A1A1A, one solid #1A1A1A tag header with a short arrow plus one headline per screen, headline 22-32pt, label 12-15pt, Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets, dashed hairline rules under every section title
